description: Returns unread/unseen notification counters by default. Fetching the notification list resets B2match's unseen counter (unseen goes to 0) even though this client never sends ReadNotification. The unread counter is unchanged. The full list requires B2MATCH_ALLOW_SIDE_EFFECT_READS=1 and acknowledge_marks_seen=true.

acknowledge_marks_seen.description: Required with B2MATCH_ALLOW_SIDE_EFFECT_READS=1 to fetch the full list; that request resets unseen.

after.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

name: list_notifications
title: List B2match notifications
